basic_info.name: Tom James Company
basic_info.description: Tom James Company is the world’s largest manufacturer and retailer of custom clothing and the engine behind some of the world’s most established tailored clothing brands. As one of the few remaining vertically integrated clothing retailers—controlling the entire manufacturing process ‘from sheep to suit’—we offer unparalleled value to those with an eye for quality.Our service model is based on a simple mantra: “We come to you with fine clothing.” Our clients never wait in line, fight for parking, or covet a garment that doesn’t come in their size. Our clients never settle, because we leverage the support of Tom James’ vertically integrated resources, nearly unlimited fabric and styling choices, plus, the technology of the digital age to offer our clients the individualized wardrobe service they prefer. Experience the Tom James difference by working with our professional clothiers to create a custom wardrobe that is tailored to your personal fashion sense. The efficiency and value of our business model allows us to span all price points, from $800, entry level fully custom suits to the most coveted, 100% handmade garments in the industry: Oxxford Clothes, based in Chicago, using Holland and Sherry cloth.Tom James Company has 97 locations worldwide, operating offices in 36 states, the United Kingdom, Australia, the Netherlands, and Canada.  If you would like to learn more about our service and products, get in touch or visit our website atwww.tomjames.comFor more on careers, visit our Instagram @tomjamescareers

basic_info.name: Tom Thumb Stores
basic_info.description: Tom Thumb provides a clean safe place for fueling your vehicle along with many convenience and fill-in items. We offer a large variety of food, snacks, and beverages both hot and cold, and the only place in the Panhandle of Florida to purchase Turkey Hill Tea and Ice Cream. W.C. Jones established Walton Grocery Company in 1953. His goal was to sell quality products and provide excellent convenient service. His first supermarket was located in De Funiak Springs, Florida. From the traditional supermarket, he began to experiment with the convenience store concept. He opened his first convenience store in Crestview, Florida. Rapid growth followed as the company moved into the beach areas along the Florida Gulf Coast and into the small rural towns. The addition of gasoline to the convenience store scene developed rapidly and gasoline became an integral part of the store. Over time, the company added fried chicken delis to multiple locations.In 1979, W.C. merged his company with two other family-owned companies to what we now know as Tom Thumb Food Stores. Rodney Jones, son of W.C. Jones, was named President of the combined companies.Today Tom Thumb Food Stores operates over 113 stores in the panhandle of Florida and southern Alabama and is owned by EG Group and operated by EG America.Tom Thumb and EG America also operate several other U.S. based subsidiary companies, including Cumberland Farms, Certified Oil, Fastrac, Kwik Shop, Loaf N Jug, Quik Stop, Turkey Hill, and Minit Mart.EG America’s parent company is EG Group, located in Blackburn, England. EG Group is the world’s leading independent fuel station and convenience retailer, with a diversified portfolio of sites across eight countries in Europe and North America. The business receives regular recognition for innovation and investment; Zuber Issa and Mohsin Issa, Founders and co-CEOs of EG Group, were jointly named the 2016 NACS Insight European Convenience Industry Leader of the Year.

basic_info.name: Tom Dixon Studio
basic_info.description: Our StoryEstablished in 2002, Tom Dixon is a British design and manufacturing brand with a commitment to innovation. We design, develop and sell extraordinary objects and spaces for everyday use, including lighting, furniture and interiors. The company has a well-established global customer base which has achieved double digit growth over recent years and is set to continue this trend over the next 5 years. The company has offices in London, New York and Hong Kong, and launches new collections annually at the Milan furniture fair. More information about us can be found at @tomdixonstudio | www.tomdixon.net

basic_info.name: Tom Tom Foundation
basic_info.description: The Tom Tom Foundation is a nonprofit events organization in Charlottesville Va. Our mission is to bring together diverse communities and spark inspiration for a brighter future. Started in 2012, our annual Tom Tom Festival now attracts 22,000+ attendees, and is co-created with hundreds of local partners who tell the story of our community’s future through music, art, and ideas each April. Throughout the year, we champion creative expression and innovation in our hometown through dance gatherings, talks, and leadership convenings. Learn more: www.tomtomfoundation.org.

basic_info.description: Tom Wood Group is a family-owned and operated organization headquartered in Central Indiana, serving customers across the Midwest and New Zealand.
